_provenance.params: doped 2D Hubbard cylinders U=8, ground-state DMRG (TeNPy 1.1, validated vs ED to 1e-6); chi cap 1200
_provenance.note: 4x3 & 4x4 SATURATED the chi=1200 cap (did not converge) -> their chi is a LOWER BOUND; ground state genuinely hard

verdict: chi grows STEEPLY with cluster size and cut boundary Ly: 4x3 (12 sites) and 4x4 (16 sites) both SATURATE chi=1200 (lower bound, under-converged). The doped 2D Hubbard ground state is genuinely hard for DMRG. BUT our SQD sampling cost tracks the SAME chi (arXiv:2608.16436) -> BOTH methods pay it -> still NO chi-gap at T=0 -> beyond-classical window EMPTY at T=0. The steep growth strengthens hardness for BOTH, not a gap for us.
